research_coverage_summary: Covered: official plugin API (Q1), security best practices (Q2), English supplement (Q3). 3 queries, 10 tier-1 sources.
open_questions: Redis vs in-memory store for production deployment?
Exact @fastify/rate-limit v8 vs v9 API differences?
version_or_dependency_note: @fastify/rate-limit latest; check compatibility with Fastify v4 vs v5
implementation_checklist: 2. Register plugin: fastify.register(rateLimit, { max: 100, timeWindow: '1 minute' })
4. Add per-route overrides for auth endpoints: { max: 5, timeWindow: '1 minute' }
5. Set trustProxy: true if behind reverse proxy
6. Add custom onExceeded handler for 429 response with Retry-After
test_checklist: Over global limit → 429 Too Many Requests
security_risk_notes: Bypass via X-Forwarded-For spoofing if trustProxy not configured. Redis failure fallback needed for distributed deployments. Not a substitute for WAF/DDoS protection.
rejected_insecure_alternatives: no rate limiting on POST/login routes
